episodes.name: Homer's Barbershop Quartet
episodes.overview: Homer recalls when he, Apu, Barney and Principal Skinner became recording icons.

episodes.name: Cape Feare
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go incognito to avoid the newly paroled Sideshow Bob, who's out to get Bart.

episodes.name: Homer Goes to College
episodes.overview: Homer takes Nuclear Physics 101 at the local college, where he gets a trio of nerdy tutors expelled for extracurricular activities.

episodes.name: Rosebud
episodes.overview: Burns longs for a childhood toy that winds up in the grip of Maggie.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror IV
episodes.overview: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

episodes.name: Marge on the Lam
episodes.overview: Marge's wild night out with neighbor Ruth includes running from the police in Ruth's car, stolen from her ex.

episodes.name: Bart's Inner Child
episodes.overview: Springfield emulates Bart after he's praised by a self-help guru.

episodes.name: Boy-Scoutz 'N the Hood
episodes.overview: After a reckless Squishee bender with Milhouse, Bart wakes to the shocking realization that he joined the Junior Campers. Lured by pocketknives and knot-tying lessons, Bart assimilates into the group but then must face the father-son rafting trip.

episodes.name: The Last Temptation of Homer
episodes.overview: Homer struggles with his attraction to new coworker Mindy, a beautiful engineer whose love for doughnuts is equal to his own.

episodes.name: $pringfield (Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
episodes.overview: Legalized gambling comes to Springfield, and Marge becomes addicted; Robert Goulet entertains at Bart's casino for kids.

episodes.name: Homer the Vigilante
episodes.overview: Homer leads a vigilante group to catch the Springfield Cat Burglar, who then robs the museum.

episodes.name: Bart Gets Famous
episodes.overview: When an on-air remark catapults Bart to instant stardom, he finds that fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

episodes.name: Homer and Apu
episodes.overview: Homer accompanies Apu to the Kwik-E-Mart home office--in India--after Apu is fired.

episodes.name: Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
episodes.overview: Lisa's outrage over the gender stereotypes reinforced by a new talking doll prompts her to confront the dollmaker.

episodes.name: Deep Space Homer
episodes.overview: Homer and Barney compete to be the first "average" American in space.

episodes.name: Homer Loves Flanders
episodes.overview: Flanders' extra ticket to the big game makes him Homer's new best friend, a role that sorely tests Flanders' patience.

episodes.name: Bart Gets an Elephant
episodes.overview: Bart wins an elephant, but Homer won't let him keep it.

episodes.name: Burns' Heir
episodes.overview: Bart is picked to be Burns' heir and moves into the Burns mansion, prompting Homer and Marge to hire a deprogrammer to get him back.

episodes.name: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
episodes.overview: Bart takes his dog to school, which gets Skinner fired, which in turn leaves Bart missing his archnemesis.

episodes.name: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
episodes.overview: Bart can clear Mayor Quimby's nephew of a charge of battery, but only by implicating himself as a hooky player.

episodes.name: Lady Bouvier's Lover
episodes.overview: Grandpa Simpson falls for Marge's mother, but loses out to a competitor; Bart gets ripped off shopping at home with Homer's credit card.

episodes.name: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
episodes.overview: Homer teaches a class on marriage, but sharing secrets about his own union gets him kicked out of the house.
